claims.text: At high temperatures, the mechanical behavior of refractory high-entropy alloys is governed by dislocation dynamics.
At high temperatures, the thermoelastic behavior of refractory high-entropy alloys is governed by dislocation dynamics.
At high temperatures, microstructural evolution governs the mechanical and thermoelastic behavior of refractory high-entropy alloys.
High-temperature in-situ TEM can directly observe dislocation dynamics in refractory high-entropy alloys.
High-temperature in-situ TEM can directly observe microstructural evolution in refractory high-entropy alloys.
Interactions among dislocations, microstructure, and impurities control the high-temperature mechanical behavior of refractory high-entropy alloys.
Interactions among dislocations, microstructure, and impurities control the high-temperature thermoelastic behavior of refractory high-entropy alloys.
Observed high-temperature dislocation dynamics and microstructural evolution will correlate directly with yield strength.
Observed high-temperature dislocation dynamics and microstructural evolution will correlate directly with ductility.
Changing impurity content is expected to affect the mechanical behavior of refractory high-entropy alloys.
Introducing dislocation sources is expected to affect the mechanical behavior of refractory high-entropy alloys.
